item.description:
Introducing the Gooti 5-in-1 Transparent Waterproof Glue, a revolutionary adhesive that combines strength, durability, and versatility. Perfect for both indoor and outdoor applications, this glue offers a seamless


⭐Key Features

💯German Formula: Engineered with precision and quality, ensuring superior performance.

💯Transparent Finish: Maintains the natural look of surfaces without leaving any visible residue.

💯High Temperature Resistance: withstands extreme temperatures without losing its adhesive properties.

💯Sun Exposure Resistant: Perfect for outdoor use where it remains stable under direct sunlight.

💯Environmentally Friendly & Non-Toxic: Safe for use around the home and family.

💯Cracks Repair with Tightness: Effectively seals and repairs cracks, providing a robust bond.

⭐Product Specifications

✨Net Weight: 600g/1000g

✨Packaging: Includes 600g/1kg of waterproof glue and a free applicator brush.

✨Texture: Smooth and easy to apply, dries clear.

✨Usage: Ideal for tiles, glass, metal, ceramics, and more.

✨Application Method: Apply with the included brush for precise and even distribution.


🔥How to Use

✨Surface Preparation: Ensure the surface is clean, dry, and free of dust or grease.

✨Application: Use the applicator brush to apply the glue evenly along the edges or joints.

✨Drying Time: Allow sufficient time for the glue to dry and cure completely before exposing to water or heavy use.

✨Maintenance: Regularly inspect the bonded areas to ensure ongoing waterproof integrity.


💥Safety Information

Avoid contact with eyes and skin. Use gloves  when applying.

Keep out of reach of children.

Ensure adequate ventilation during use.
